sentence: This project develops an antibody-based treatment for severe hemorrhagic fever caused by mammarenaviruses.
This project tests how different amounts of backward walking training help Veterans after a stroke and uses magnetic resonance imaging to look at brain activity.
This project runs a shared facility that helps researchers study extracellular vesicles, including experimental design, data collection, analysis and storage.
This project studies how genes linked to orofacial cleft work and looks for genes regulated by them in the embryonic periderm.
This project studies how marine Vibrio bacteria combine quorum sensing signals with environmental signals to control genes needed for disease and development.
This project uses mouse models and cell lines to study how mammalian telomere ends are protected, kept at length and copied.
This project uses MRI to look at the structure and function of tiny lung airspaces in young adults with low lung function or breathing symptoms.
This project studies how mesenchymal cells decide what type of epithelial cells form in developing salivary glands.
This project uses high-throughput assays and genome-scale approaches to find and study DNA variants linked to cardiovascular disease.
This project builds an AI model that measures experimental autoimmune uveitis in animals from eye images and gathers labeled image collections.
This project develops nanoprobes for MRI that aim to image neurotrophic receptors in Alzheimer's disease noninvasively.
This project studies what causes congenital disorders of glycosylation and screens repurposed drugs to find possible treatments.
This project tests whether a change in transitional care rules helps children with serious illness who receive hospice and medical care together.
This project studies how a signaling activator protein controls apical constriction in early vertebrate embryos.
This project offers shared imaging and functional testing of animals, so researchers can watch living animals over time and use fewer animals.
This project tests whether a self-guided program delivered through the internet helps Veterans with depressive symptoms and restores their functioning.
This project uses optical tweezers and fluorescence microscopy to measure the forces that proteins use to join membranes and move lipids between them.
This project studies how Stabilin receptors take part in starting rheumatoid arthritis in the joints and across the body.
This project studies how respiratory viral infections in children lead to asthma, using the nasal transcriptome and mouse models of asthma.
This project uses CRISPR gene editing to make changes in mammalian cells, mostly human cells, and to create mutant mice for researchers.
